notablePrerequisites: Marath has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
description:
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Elemental creture token.
The Elemental enters the battlefield, triggering Cathars' Crusade, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Elemental, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
